mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines month-over-month, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS decline on 20-day returns is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals labor market deterioration and weak economic growth, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE > 5.0% on 20-day returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with low year-over-year inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY < 3.0%) indicates a favorable monetary policy environment that avoids stagflation, boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary policy easing with low inflation
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL YoY < 3.0%, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions, a month-over-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) reflects robust consumer demand and economic resilience, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST increases during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC for HOUST increase in late-cycle expansions is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly non-farm payrolls growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 200,000 jobs, it signals strong labor market conditions and rising consumer spending, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS growth > 200k, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS growth > 200k on 20-day returns is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS increases month-over-month, or the Rank IC for RSAFS increase is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) grows at a rate exceeding 0.5% month-over-month, it signals immediate manufacturing strength, supporting near-term equity performance and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC for INDPRO growth > 0.5% on 5-day returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) grows at a rate exceeding 0.5% month-over-month, it signals sustained economic expansion, supporting long-term equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC for INDPRO growth > 0.5% on 60-day returns is below 0.03.
